title: E2 rerun: runtime-invoked skill and premature-finish guard (preregistered)
hypothesis: Wiring an inherited skill into the controller helps small models more than offering tools alone; a premature-finish guard helps models that stop early.
finding: Preregistered verdicts: H_E2 controller vs none inconclusive (3 wins, 0 losses, p=0.125); H_G guard vs none inconclusive (1-0, p=0.5); H_GC both vs controller rejected (1 win, 4 losses): the guard adds nothing on top of the controller. No preregistered hypothesis is supported. Qwen solved these tasks without help (none 11/12), so success had little room to move; LFM2.5 stayed near zero in every arm (best: controller 2/12).

exploratory.note: Not preregistered. Written after the verdicts above.
exploratory.noise_floor: The guard never fired for Qwen, so for Qwen guard=none and both=controller in treatment. Those identical-treatment pairs still disagreed in 3 of 24 units (llama.cpp Metal sampling is not bit-exact). The H_E2 margin (3-0 over 24 units) is the same size as this noise.
exploratory.efficiency: Qwen controller vs none: fewer model steps in 10/12 paired units and more in 0 (median 11 vs 20); fewer executor actions in 10/12 even counting the runtime's own test runs (138 vs 193 total); faster in 8/12 (median 45 s saved). none hit the 20-step cap in 7/12 runs, controller in 1/12. Committed 12/12 vs 10/12.
exploratory.guard: On LFM2.5 the guard fired in 6/12 guard runs and 12/12 'both' runs and roughly doubled its tool calls (35 to 67), but produced 0 and 1 successes. Stopping early is not what limits LFM2.5 here; it acts and still does not produce a correct patch.
exploratory.controller_silence: With test results already in its first message, LFM2.5 ended without any tool call in 5/12 controller and 4/12 'both' runs (0/12 in none and guard).
exploratory.reasoning_exhaustion: All 4 'error' runs (3 of them Qwen's only failures, all on e2d) are the same mechanism: the model spent the full 4096-token completion budget on reasoning and emitted no text or tool call three turns in a row. The loop has no recovery for this today.

limits: Four small synthetic tasks by the same author as the arms; Qwen near ceiling; seeds vary sampling only. Exploratory observations above need their own preregistration before any claim.
analysis_code: bench/summarize_e2.py (verdicts and table); finding/exploratory/limits added by hand afterwards
